note: ANSWER KEY. The reconciliation engine never reads this file. It exists so the engine can be scored honestly against known truth.

statutory_position.tds_194o: NOT deducted. Razorpay acts as payment aggregator, not e-commerce operator. Absent by design.
statutory_position.gst_tcs_52: NOT applicable. Not a marketplace ECO. Absent by design.
statutory_position.upi_mdr: Zero MDR by statute (Sec 10A PSS Act). Fee and tax are 0 on UPI rows.

edge_cases.description: Partial refunds issued after the original sale settled; the refund debit appears in a later settlement batch than the sale it relates to.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Matcher must link the refund to its original payment_id across batches, not flag it as an unexplained debit.

edge_cases.description: A chargeback debits both the disputed transaction value and a Rs 750 handling fee from a later settlement.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Classified CHARGEBACK, linked to the original payment, not counted as a fee variance.

edge_cases.description: Orders captured inside the settlement cycle window, so they legitimately appear in no settlement batch yet.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Reported NOT_YET_SETTLED (benign), never as missing money.

edge_cases.description: A captured transaction flagged on_hold=true and withheld from the payout as a risk reserve.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Excluded from the expected payout total. Must NOT be treated as missing money.

edge_cases.description: One transaction charged MDR at 2.4% instead of the contracted 2.0%.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Flagged FEE_DEDUCTION with the rupee overcharge quantified.

edge_cases.description: GST on the fee computed at 12% instead of the statutory 18%.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Flagged TAX_DEDUCTION; understated GST distorts the ITC claim.

edge_cases.description: A single day's transactions were paid out across two settlement batches (setl_XirZRiRBaepZIT and setl_kM3u5c1f6VqnJM).
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Both batches match independently; the day's orders reconcile only when combined.

edge_cases.description: Bank credit for UTR 666690337n24 landed 3 days after the settlement date (bank holiday).
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Still matched (amount agrees) but flagged TIMING_LAG, which is benign.

edge_cases.description: Bank recorded the UTR as '478833337H8' where Razorpay recorded '478833337h83' (uppercased and truncated).
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Exact UTR string match fails. Must still match on amount+date with downgraded confidence, NOT drop the match.

edge_cases.description: Two unrelated settlements carry visually similar UTRs ('206389694w93' vs '206389694wxy').
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: A fuzzy-UTR matcher would conflate these. Correct behaviour is to match on amount + date and keep them distinct.

edge_cases.description: Monthly GST invoice tax (Rs 1,238.79) differs from summed per-transaction tax (Rs 1,240.22) by -Rs 1.43 from accumulated per-transaction rounding.
edge_cases.expected_behaviour: Within monthly tolerance -> ROUNDING, ITC still claimable, journal adjustment noted.
